mapper.sql: select s.station_id, s.station_name, s.location, s.capacity_mw, s.tag_id, t.tag_name, s.legacy_firebase_id, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.remark from pv_station s left join pv_station_tag t on t.tag_id = s.tag_id

select g.gateway_id, g.station_id, s.station_name, g.gateway_name, g.gateway_type, g.serial_number, g.status, g.communication_type, g.protocol, g.broker_url, g.topic, g.polling_interval_sec, g.last_seen, g.legacy_firebase_id, g.create_by, g.create_time, g.update_by, g.update_time, g.remark from pv_gateway g left join pv_station s on s.station_id = g.station_id

select i.inverter_id, i.gateway_id, g.gateway_name, i.model_id, m.brand, m.model_name, i.inverter_number, i.serial_number, i.status, i.last_seen, i.current_power, i.daily_yield, i.legacy_firebase_id, i.create_by, i.create_time, i.update_by, i.update_time, i.remark from pv_inverter i left join pv_gateway g on g.gateway_id = i.gateway_id left join pv_inverter_model m on m.model_id = i.model_id
